Package com.nexuslink.protocol.ai.llm

package com.nexuslink.protocol.ai.llm
  • Class
    Description
    AnthropicService
    Thin wrapper over the official Anthropic Java SDK for the "AI Agent / LLM" tester panel.
    AnthropicService.Result
    Result of a completion: text + token usage, or an error message.
    HttpLlmClient
    Calls any LlmEndpointConfig over plain HTTP — the path used for internal gateways and self-hosted models, where the vendor SDK's assumptions about hostnames and API keys don't hold.
    LlmEndpointConfig
    A fully described LLM endpoint: where to send the request, in which wire format, how to authenticate, and every generation parameter to send with it.
    LlmEndpointConfig.Api
    The request/response wire format the endpoint speaks.
    LlmEndpointConfig.Auth
    How the endpoint authenticates the caller.
    LlmEndpointStore
    Persists configured LLM endpoints in ~/.nexuslink/llm-endpoints.json.
    LlmEndpointStore.Data
    On-disk shape — an object wrapper so the format can gain fields later.
    LlmRequestBuilder
    Builds the JSON request body for an LlmEndpointConfig, in whichever wire format the endpoint speaks.
    LlmResponseParser
    Extracts the assistant's text, token usage and stop reason from either wire format, and turns an error payload into a readable message.
    OidcTokenSource
    Fetches OIDC / OAuth2 access tokens with the client-credentials grant — the flow an internal service-to-service API is normally protected by — and caches them until shortly before they expire.
    OidcTokenSource.LlmException
    Raised when an endpoint or its identity provider can't be used.
